dish.title: Enfrijoladas: Corn Tortillas in Smoky Pinto Bean Sauce with Zucchini and Poblano
dish.description: Warm corn tortillas dipped in a silky chipotle pinto bean sauce, folded around sauteed zucchini, corn, and poblano, then blanketed with more sauce and finished with avocado, radish, cilantro, and lime.

recipe_version.title: Enfrijoladas: Corn Tortillas in Smoky Pinto Bean Sauce with Zucchini and Poblano
recipe_version.description: Warm corn tortillas dipped in a silky chipotle pinto bean sauce, folded around sauteed zucchini, corn, and poblano, then blanketed with more sauce and finished with avocado, radish, cilantro, and lime.

ingredients.name: white onion
ingredients.note: half for the sauce, half for the filling

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: plus more to thin if needed, up to 1/4 cup

ingredients.name: corn tortillas
ingredients.display_name: 6-inch corn tortillas whose label lists corn, water, and lime only

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Drain and rinse the beans. Chop the onion, smash the garlic, and dice the zucchini and poblano. Slice the avocado and radishes, chop the cilantro, and cut the limes into wedges.

steps.title: Make the bean sauce
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a 3-quart saucepan over medium and cook half the onion with the garlic until soft, about 4 minutes. Add the beans, chipotles, adobo, cumin, 1 tsp salt, and 1 1/2 cups water and simmer 5 minutes. Blend until very smooth, return to the pan, and keep warm over low, thinning with up to 1/4 cup more water so it pours like heavy cream.

steps.title: Saute the filling
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Cook the rest of the onion, the zucchini, and the poblano until browned at the edges and tender-crisp, about 7 minutes. Add the corn and 3/4 tsp salt for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Warm and assemble
steps.body: Warm the tortillas one at a time in a dry 10-inch skillet over medium until pliable, about 20 seconds per side. Dip each warm tortilla in the bean sauce, lay it on a plate, add a spoonful of filling, and fold into quarters or in half. Three per plate.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon more bean sauce over the folded tortillas and top with avocado, radishes, and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.
